campaign_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export PLOW_MLA_PF_V2=1 PLOW_MLA_PF_AITER=1 PLOW_PF_CHUNK=8192 PLOW_PF_INTERLEAVE=0
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$ROCM_PATH/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
root=/tmp/tp-glm53-fp8-b20
if [ "$#" = 0 ]; then set -- b20 b16; fi
for arm in "$@"; do
    export PLOW_HSACO="$root/overlay"
    "$root/plowrt" serve --assets "$root/assets-$arm" --port 18987 > "$root/server-$arm.log" 2>&1 &
    server=$!
    trap 'kill -TERM "$server" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$server" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
    ready=0
    for attempt in $(seq 1 180); do
        if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:18987/v1/models > "$root/models-$arm.json" 2>/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi
        kill -0 "$server" || exit 1
        sleep 1
    done
    [ "$ready" = 1 ]
    python3 runtime/bench/amd/mla_sparse_aiter/quality.py http://127.0.0.1:18987 "fp8-$arm" "$root/quality-$arm.json" --concurrency 20 > "$root/quality-$arm.log" 2>&1
    env VLLM_ROCM_LIB=/opt/rocm/core-7.14/lib /app/plow/build-gemma31/vllm-python -m vllm.entrypoints.cli.main bench serve --backend vllm --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18987 --model glm-5.3-plow-lite --tokenizer zai-org/GLM-5.3 --trust-remote-code --dataset-name random --num-prompts 20 --random-input-len 70000 --random-output-len 700 --random-range-ratio 0.14 --max-concurrency 20 --save-result --save-detailed --result-dir "$root" --result-filename "serve-$arm.json" > "$root/bench-$arm.log" 2>&1
    kill -TERM "$server"
    wait "$server" || [ "$?" = 143 ]
    trap - EXIT
done
limitations: Single ordered pair with CPU compiler activity; repeat under a quiet host before choosing defaults.
FP8 held constant; this isolates capacity within FP8 and does not compare KV numerical formats.
Only 5/20 generated texts identical; retrieval is not broad quality equivalence.
Larger batch improves throughput but worsens mean/P99 TPOT.
Narrow-tier dispatch qualification is separate and pending.
